Day hikes

Five maintained trails, from a flat stroll along the lake to a full day in the snow. Mileage is round trip. Grab a paper map at either entrance station, because your phone won't work past the lodge.

Bring water, a warm layer and a headlamp. There's no cell coverage past the lodge.
